request: Sixty-third build (incremental on the sixty-second, run 43573206423). Build 62's new check caught a drift: thiserror/v1/BUILD.gn lost build/probe.rs from its build_script_inputs, because that file never reached the commit (the root .gitignore ignores build/, so neither the copy-back's git status nor the dump saw it). Now nothing under src/third_party/rust is ignored, and vendor-rust-crates.sh copies back the files Chromium's checkout ignores too, NUL-separated. This build prints the complete tree (vendor_dump) and runs the tests and the typed spoken suite on it.
